etaMax.source: ATLAS and CMS inner trackers cover |η| < 2.5, e.g. CMS, JINST 3 (2008) S08004.

muonPtResolutionConstant.source: Muon momentum resolution of about 1–2 % for pT below 100 GeV in the barrel, CMS JINST 3 (2008) S08004; ATLAS JINST 3 (2008) S08003. Simplification: σ(pT)/pT = a ⊕ b·pT with constant a.

muonPtResolutionSlope.source: Resolution degrades to roughly 10 % at 1 TeV, CMS JINST 3 (2008) S08004. Simplification: linear term b.

muonEfficiency.source: Muon reconstruction and identification efficiencies are typically 90–98 %, e.g. CMS, JINST 13 (2018) P06015. Simplification: a single value.

photonEnergyResolution.source: Electromagnetic calorimeter resolution of about 1–2 % for photons above 50 GeV, CMS JINST 3 (2008) S08004. Simplification: constant.
